headline: Command Room Hub: one private page with a Start button for your morning.

items.prompt_template: This update adds Command Room Hub, one private page with a Start button that preps your next meetings, drafts replies for your inbox and shows your plate, with Done, Snooze and Undo on each item. Say "set up my hub" to make yours. Your scheduled chats come down to Morning Brief and Maintenance; the work of the others moves onto the Hub. Files Command Room makes for you now come back as a file card.
